text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, is it post time yet?
I wanna run already~~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't run the way I wanted to last time,
but I'm totally different today~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you a run that'll blow you away, Trainie!
So you'd better not miss the moment I cross the finish line~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And also~... make sure you think of
a celebration for when I win, okay?♪
